# Spill

> Spill (spillcampus.vercel.app) is an anonymous confession wall for students of Bundelkhand University, Jhansi (BU Jhansi), India. Students post confessions, rants and questions under a made-up name — no sign-up, no email, no real names. It is a student-made community site and is not affiliated with Bundelkhand University.

Not to be confused with SPILL, the US social app by former Twitter employees, or any other product named Spill. This Spill is a campus wall for Bundelkhand University, Jhansi, launched in November 2026.

## How it works

- Identity is a random or self-chosen made-up name, with a 5-word login phrase. No email, phone number or password is ever collected.
- Anyone can read the wall. Posting, replying and reacting need a made-up name.
- Private messages are consent-first: one person requests, the other accepts, only then can they talk.
- A post that receives 3 reports from different readers is hidden automatically.

## Pages

- [Home / the wall](https://spillcampus.vercel.app/): the live confession feed for BU Jhansi students
- [Privacy](https://spillcampus.vercel.app/): how anonymity and data work on Spill
- [Terms](https://spillcampus.vercel.app/): the house rules for posting

## Key facts

- Audience: students of Bundelkhand University, Jhansi (Uttar Pradesh, India)
- Tagline: same campus, everything unsaid
- Instagram: @spillcampus.bu
- Cost: free, no accounts, no ads
